_about: Production config on CT122 (2026-10-30): straight to zpd on loopback, asking as the PUBLIC host name so zpd's own host map is a second barrier (it serves only zarr.icos-cp.eu's stores to that name) under this file's default-deny. No token stores yet: a token store with no tokens is refused at load, and none are issued. forward_client_ip: zpd on loopback believes X-Real-IP, so passports and the proxy's Matomo logging see the end user.
